subject: Code review: Changes requested for AMSD-2041

body.text: Code review identified issues that need to be addressed.

issues.description: No unit test verifies the new live_preview configuration in the exported options object. The existing test file already tests options.fetchOptions (lines ~120-140) but does not assert that options.live_preview is present with enable, host, and management_token. Per review criterion #2, new features require corresponding unit tests. A trivial test checking `expect(testedModule.options.live_preview).toEqual({ enable: true, host: expect.any(String), management_token: expect.any(String) })` would close this gap.
issues.suggestedFix: Add an it() block inside the existing `describe('contentstack', ...)` that requires the module and asserts `options.live_preview` contains `enable: true`, `host`, and `management_token`, mirroring the existing fetch-timeout option tests.
